purpose: Requirements for the evaluator agent in the review mechanism: how it independently verifies reviewer findings using meta-perspectives, decides dispositions, and reports evaluations.
summary: Overview: evaluator independently verifies findings, rejects wrong ones, and points to root causes
Scope: only evaluator-specific behavior; exchange, numbering, exit values and data structures are delegated to the common review contract
FNC-208: contents of the evaluator definition, reading from findings outward, target-kind judgment shared with the reviewer
FNC-201: five meta-perspectives questioning root cause, source information, existing decisions, reasonable reading, and own judgment
FNC-206: evaluator may newly raise findings missed by the reviewer, with valid disposition and explicit location
FNC-209: evaluations are written only after all judgments are finalized; zero findings does not imply zero evaluations
FNC-319: evaluator has no error values; only normal exit "0" is passed
DM-202: inputs are the request and findings, read separately without a merged input file
TBD-001: practical effectiveness of the meta-perspectives is unverified until after implementation
tasks: Writing or modifying the evaluator agent definition
Implementing new-finding handling by the evaluator
Designing evaluator exit and error handling
title: REQ-026 evaluator の独立評価とメタ観点 要件定義書
